question: What was settled revenue in H1 2026?

input.sql: select p.status, count(*), sum(p.amount) amt, sum(o.gross_amount) gross, sum(o.gross_amount-o.discount_amount) net, sum(case when p.amount=o.gross_amount then 1 else 0 end) eq_gross, sum(case when p.amount=o.gross_amount-o.discount_amount then 1 else 0 end) eq_net, min(p.payment_date), max(p.payment_date), min(o.order_date), max(o.order_date) from payments p join orders o using(order_id) group by 1

select sum(p.amount) amt, sum(o.gross_amount-o.discount_amount) net, count(*) from payments p join orders o using(order_id) where p.status='settled' and p.payment_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30'
select count(*), sum(r.refund_amount), sum(case when p.status='settled' then 1 else 0 end) settled_refunds from refunds r join payments p using(payment_id)

input.answer_text: Settled revenue in H1 2026 was $14,097,425.35. It covers 2,422 payments with status 'settled', dated 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30. Payment amount equals gross minus discount, so discounts are already netted out. Pending, failed, chargeback, voided and refunded payments are excluded. Refunds apply only to payments with status 'refunded', so none are subtracted from this figure. Summing all payments would give about $17.4M.

question: What was settled revenue in January 2026?

input.sql:
select 
 sum(case when o.order_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-31' then p.amount end) as amt_by_order_month,
 sum(case when p.payment_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-31' then p.amount end) as amt_by_pay_month,
 sum(case when o.order_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-31' then o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount end) as net_by_order_month,
 sum(case when o.order_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-31' then o.gross_amount end) as gross_by_order_month,
 sum(case when p.payment_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-01-31' then o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount end) as net_by_pay_month
from payments p join orders o using(order_id) where p.status='settled'

select count(*), sum(case when abs(p.amount-(o.gross_amount-o.discount_amount))<0.01 then 1 else 0 end) as eq_net, sum(case when abs(p.amount-o.gross_amount)<0.01 then 1 else 0 end) as eq_gross from payments p join orders o using(order_id)

input.answer_text: January 2026 settled revenue was $2,487,398.51. This is net of discounts (gross minus discount, which equals payments.amount), counts only payments with status 'settled', and assigns payments to the month of their order date. Caveat: if you assign by payment date instead, the figure is $2,270,505.12, because some payments land up to 75 days after the order. Gross before discounts would be $2,705,974.24, which overstates revenue. Refunded payments are excluded because they are not 'settled'.

question: What was settled revenue in Q2 2026?

input.sql:
select 'pay_date' basis, sum(p.amount) pay_amt, sum(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount) net_amt, sum(o.gross_amount) gross, count(*) n from payments p join orders o using(order_id) where p.status='settled' and p.payment_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-06-30'
union all
select 'order_date', sum(p.amount), sum(o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount), sum(o.gross_amount), count(*) from payments p join orders o using(order_id) where p.status='settled' and o.order_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-06-30'

select count(*) n, sum(case when p.amount = o.gross_amount - o.discount_amount then 1 else 0 end) eq_net, sum(case when p.amount = o.gross_amount then 1 else 0 end) eq_gross from payments p join orders o using(order_id) where p.status='settled'

input.answer_text: Settled revenue in Q2 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30) was $7,383,779.56. That is the sum of payments.amount where status = 'settled' and payment_date falls in Q2, across 1,272 payments. The amount is already net of order-level discounts. It matches gross_amount minus discount_amount on every settled payment. Caveats: pending, failed, chargeback, voided and refunded payments are excluded. I bucketed by payment date. Bucketing by order date gives $7,069,226.39 instead. Some late-landing payments (up to 75 days after the order) may still be missing from late June.

question: How many payment attempts were there in H1 2026?

input.sql: select count(*) n, min(payment_date), max(payment_date), sum(case when payment_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30' then 1 else 0 end) in_h1 from payments
select count(*) from payments p join orders o using(order_id) where o.order_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30'

input.answer_text: There were 3,000 payment attempts in H1 2026. That counts every row in payments, whatever its status: settled, pending_settlement, failed, chargeback, voided or refunded. All 3,000 have a payment_date in H1, and the same 3,000 also have an order_date in H1, so the count is the same whichever date you use. Only about 80% of these are settled payments that count as revenue.

select status, count(*) n from payments where payment_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-06-30' group by status order by n desc
